headline: Easy long run after Saturday’s pool swim
summary: Garmin recorded 7h 11m sleep (score 80), sleeping heart rate 64 bpm, overnight HRV 42 ms, Body Battery 80 on waking, and Training Readiness 75. Saturday's 1.05 km pool swim was useful lower-impact training but did not match the prescribed easy run or approved alternative. Run 75–90 minutes easy today, approximately 11–14 km, with no quality work.

yesterday.title: Saturday easy-run prescription versus completed pool swim
yesterday.summary: The prescription was 35–45 minutes of easy running, with easy walking or complete rest as the lower-load alternative. Garmin recorded one pool swim instead.
yesterday.prescribed: Run 35–45 minutes easy, approximately 6–7 km, with no strides, hills, tempo work, intervals, or added distance. Approved lower-load alternative: 25–30 minutes of easy walking or full rest.
yesterday.completed: One lap-swimming activity: 1.05 km in 25m 54s, Garmin moving pace approximately 1:50/100 m (2:28/100 m including rests), average HR 123, maximum HR 161, training load 56, aerobic effect 2.1, and anaerobic effect 2.0.
yesterday.adherence_assessment: The swim supplied a modest lower-impact training stimulus, but it was neither the prescribed easy run nor the approved walking/rest alternative. The anaerobic training effect also means it cannot be assumed to have been entirely easy.
adherence_evidence: Garmin lists one lap-swimming activity with a 19 September Sydney start time.
The swim lasted 25m 54s and recorded training load 56, aerobic effect 2.1, and anaerobic effect 2.0.
No running or walking activity was recorded on 19 September.
adherence_caveats: Garmin cannot verify perceived effort, pain, illness, swim-set structure, or intent.
The moving pace excludes rest time; the elapsed-equivalent pace includes it.

environment.observed_temperature_range: No reliable temperature measurement was present for the pool swim.
environment.humidity_dew_point_context: City-level humidity and dew point were not used because this was a pool activity and route-level outdoor exposure was not established.
environment.heat_impact_interpretation: No heat-related performance inference was made.
environment.limitations: The Garmin activity identifies lap swimming but does not establish indoor versus outdoor pool conditions.

recommendation.title: 75–90 minutes easy today
details: Run 75–90 minutes at conversational effort, approximately 11–14 km if pace naturally falls in your recent easy range.
Keep the whole run easy: no fast finish, strides, hills, tempo work, intervals, or make-up pace.
Fuel and hydrate normally, and shorten the run if effort or heart rate is unusually high during the first 15–20 minutes.
recommendation.alternative: Run 45–60 minutes easy, approximately 7–9 km, or take 30–45 minutes of easy walking or full rest if you do not feel well recovered.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Reduce or stop for pain, illness, dizziness, altered gait, unusual fatigue, chest symptoms, or other concerning symptoms. Symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.

caveats: Garmin sleep, heart-rate, HRV, stress, Body Battery, readiness, and load measures are wearable-derived; use trends alongside how you feel.
Today's stress and Body Battery values are incomplete morning measures.
Sleeping-heart-rate baselines exclude the current night and use the prior seven and fourteen valid nights.
Swimming pace depends on whether rest time is included; both moving and elapsed-equivalent figures are stated.
